$Comment: Every boss and elite of the game's own, as one group: the bosses (Zig_Bosses) and the elites (Zig_Elites), each listed there by exact role id. Every foe family excludes this group, so no foe-family bonus counts a boss or an elite. What a boss or an elite takes of each kind of crowd control is each kind's own rule (OnBossOrElite on the Control Kinds screen, /zigadmin), and a boss's own NPC group can carry ZigControlLands and ZigControlShrugs tags to set its own. A mod's own boss or elite is counted by an NPC group of its own tagged ZigRank Boss or Elite; it never needs to change this file. To keep bosses and elites out of a proc's Area or a Target, ask { "Id": "ZigBossOrElite", "Inverse": true }; to ask whether one kind of control lands, { "Id": "ZigControl", "Kind": "Push", "ByTalent": true }. A roaming boss goes in Zig_World_Bosses, any other game role in Zig_Bosses or Zig_Elites.
